title: MCP servers that never connect
source: unverified: failed servers read from transcript attachments (internal format); setting deniedMcpServers (entry {"serverName": ...}) documented at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp

fix.text: Block MCP servers that failed to connect in several sessions and never connected in any of them (deniedMcpServers). A server that is configured but dead still costs startup time. Servers that only time out sometimes are left alone. Delete the entry to bring a server back.
